lore: Each realm sails as one squadron, and from the signal tower Signal Yeoman Marisol runs a single flag up the mast for each of them: green when every island in the squadron rides easy, amber when one is near its limit, red when one is over or a world cannot keep all its islands afloat. She also checks the squadron rolls against the ships actually in harbour and hoists a query pennant when they disagree.

lines.fair: Green flags on every mast. The whole fleet rides easy.
lines.signal: An amber flag is flying. One squadron has an island close to its limit.
lines.distress: Red at the masthead. A squadron has an island over budget or a world it cannot hold.
